alerts.title: Ice, yellow level, Parts of Troms and West-Finnmark, 2026-11-24T08:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-25T08:00:00+00:00
alerts.description: There is risk of glaze ice, due to increasing temperatures. Locally rain could freeze on the ground, as well as on vehicles and other objects. The temperatures increase first in the north and outer areas.
alerts.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Consider using ice spikes or studded shoes: Be aware that the ice can be difficult to see. Follow the updates: Stay updated on weather warnings. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk.
